name: Ingest
description: Imports a footage folder, mirroring its folder tree as bins. Runs the same import as Ingest + Proxies, stopping before proxies. Video and audio only; a RED .RDC folder becomes one clip (first .R3D), as Media Browser does: normal-speed RED clips carry their sound inside the R3D; slow-motion clips have none and their separate .wav is left out unless switched on; Exports/Renders/Proxies/cache folders are skipped; files already in the project are skipped. Optionally makes one linked R3D+wav sequence per RED clip with a wav, in a Synced bin (Premiere cannot script Merge Clips). Preview shows the plan without importing.

inputs.label: Make linked R3D+wav sequences (needs the .wav option)

prompts.title: Step 1 of 1: choose the FOOTAGE folder to import
prompts.explain:
Step 1 of 1: FOOTAGE

A folder window will open. Choose the folder of camera footage to bring into the open Premiere project, e.g. a shoot-day folder that holds the camera card folders.

Its folder tree becomes bins in the project. Files already in the project are skipped. No proxies are made.
